candidates.change_summary: Remove the require check for overflow-safe addition, allowing unchecked balance addition.
Remove the msg.value >= MinDeposit check, so any deposit amount updates balances.
Replace `balances[msg.sender]+=msg.value` with a smaller increment, e.g., 1 wei, so final balance differs.
Change require condition to always revert, preventing any balance update.
Replace `balances[msg.sender]` on left side of addition with a constant address like `address(0)`, updating a different key.
Replace the deposit guard condition `msg.value >= MinDeposit` with `msg.value > MinDeposit`, so a deposit exactly equal to MinDeposit no longer updates balances.
Delete the overflow check require statement in Deposit, allowing balances[msg.sender] += msg.value to wrap and store a different value for large deposits.
Replace the balance update `balances[msg.sender]+=msg.value` with an assignment that overwrites the caller's balance with msg.value, changing the stored balance whenever a prior balance is nonzero.
Delete the TransferLog.AddMessage logging call in Deposit; balances still changes, but this removes the only side effect other than the balance update.
Replaced the outer `if(_am<=balances[msg.sender])` guard with `if(true)`, removing the balance sufficiency check so CashOut can proceed regardless of the caller's balance underflow rules.
Changed the balance subtraction to an addition, so CashOut increases the caller's recorded balance instead of decreasing it.
Changed the post-CashOut log message tag from "CashOut" to "Deposit".

Moved the state update `balances[msg.sender] = balances[msg.sender] - _am` from before the external call to after the call returns successfully, making the balance change observable to a re-entering callee during the call.
Change the CashOut permission check from `_am <= balances[msg.sender]` to `_am < balances[msg.sender]` so exact-balance withdrawals revert instead of completing.
Delete the balance-reduction statement before the external call, so the external call can proceed without first reducing the caller's balance.
Move the balance-reduction state update from before the external call to after it, allowing reentrant withdrawal with the old balance visible during the call.
Delete the success-check condition so the CashOut function still updates state and returns even when the external call fails.
Replace the revert in the failed-call branch with a no-op so a failed external call no longer reverts the CashOut transaction.
Replace the deposit amount check with a tautological condition, allowing zero-value Deposit calls to complete.
Replace the deposit amount check with a false condition, making all Deposit calls revert.
Replace the overflow check to always require false, causing Deposit to revert for all inputs.
Replace the balance update so it no longer adds the deposited amount, leaving balances unchanged.
Replace the log message value with zero, so Log records a zero value for successful deposits.
